evals.prompt: Can you transcribe this interview.mp4 for me? I need to find the exact moment someone says a specific line so I can clip it.
evals.expected_output: Should extract audio from the video if needed, then transcribe using Deepgram nova-2 with word-level timestamps enabled (words=true), falling back to ElevenLabs then local Whisper only if Deepgram is unavailable. Should return/save the word-level array, not just a flat transcript string, since the stated goal requires locating an exact moment.
assertions: Extracts audio from the video before transcribing (or transcribes directly if already audio)
Uses Deepgram nova-2 with word-level timestamps as the default, falling back only if unavailable
Confirms the response includes a per-word start/end array, not just sentence-level timing
Returns or saves the word-level data rather than only the transcript text

evals.prompt: Deepgram isn't set up for me right now, can you still get a word-level transcript of this podcast.mp3?
evals.expected_output: Should fall through to ElevenLabs speech-to-text, and if that's also unavailable, to local Whisper with word timestamps enabled (e.g. --word_timestamps True). Should not silently accept a transcription result that lacks per-word timing at any fallback stage.
assertions: Falls back through ElevenLabs then local Whisper in that order
Ensures word-level timestamps are enabled at whichever fallback stage is used
Does not accept a sentence-level-only transcript as a substitute
